{{Top|leg}}
The '''Survivor's Fund''' was a type of donation fund that was mentioned in the base recreation area of [[Ciutric IV]], when [[Delak Krennel|Prince-Admiral Delak Krennel]] sent out an order for his troops to go to their ships. [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] was at the time under cover within the Prince-Admiral's troops, along with the other members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. When the call came, he was engaged in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] with some of the other troops, and was informed, upon the call's arrival, that Sabacc pots abandoned in such a situation went to what was called the "Survivor's Fund," presumably a donation fund for the families of those killed in battle.
